properties.name: Pandion global range (Western and Eastern Osprey combined)
properties.attribution: Zoologist / chris; map contributors Jdcollins13, Shyamal, Liandrei; see Commons file history
properties.derivation: Original filled SVG Bezier paths flattened and inverse-georeferenced from a global Robinson projection; no invented biological boundaries. Geographic longitudes unwrapped, split at +/-180, and normalized.
properties.limitations: Georeferenced illustration, not expert-authored GIS polygons; source combines Western and Eastern Osprey; approximate illustrated boundaries and source age retained. Fit residual includes differences between generalized base coastlines, missing lakes and islands.
